title.en: Save to a file, read it back

hints.tr: pickle bayt yazar ve okur; dosya ikili kipte açılmalı.
hints.en: pickle writes and reads bytes; the file must be opened in binary mode.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
import pickle


def save_and_load(path, obj):
    with open(path, "wb") as file:
        pickle.dump(obj, file)
    with open(path, "rb") as file:
        return pickle.load(file)

print(save_and_load("scores.pkl", {"ada": [90, 85]}))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
import pickle


def save_and_load(path, obj):
    with open(path, "wb") as file:
        pickle.dump(obj, file)
    with open(path, "rb") as file:
        return pickle.load(file)

print(save_and_load("scores.pkl", {"ada": [90, 85]}))
```
